display.purpose: Declared serif fallback stack for shared brand and section headings; font files are not bundled/imported.

body.purpose: Declared sans-serif stack for controls, navigation and body copy; DM Sans may fall back to the system face.

label.purpose: Small tracked uppercase labels for navigation groups and table headings.

shadows.name: admin-dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: Admin dialog separation from the workspace.

motion.name: shared-state-transition
motion.purpose: Shared color, border, shadow and transform transitions.

motion.name: admin-menu-entry
motion.purpose: Short vertical fade/slide for admin menus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main confirm or commit action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:11px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 11px); background:var(--accent, #1D4F5E); color:white; font:inherit; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.1; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(29,79,94,.18); transition:transform var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), background-color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), border-color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), box-shadow var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover,.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background:var(--accent-soft, #3D7A8C); color:white; transform:translateY(-1px); outline:none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action with a clear boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:11px 17px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong, #D8D2C8); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 11px); background:rgba(255,255,255,.74); color:var(--ink, #1A202C); font:inherit; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), border-color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover,.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { background:white; border-color:rgba(61,122,140,.36); color:var(--accent, #1D4F5E); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet action that does not compete with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:11px 17px; border:1px solid rgba(29,79,94,.5); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 11px); background:transparent; color:var(--accent, #1D4F5E); font:inherit; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover,.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background:rgba(29,79,94,.06); color:var(--accent, #1D4F5E); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive action with muted red fill and explicit wording.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:11px 17px; border:1px solid rgba(197,48,48,.15); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 11px); background:rgba(197,48,48,.08); color:var(--error, #C53030); font:inherit; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)); } .ds-btn-danger:hover,.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { background:rgba(197,48,48,.14); color:var(--error, #C53030); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A shared single-line field with a warm surface and teal focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--slate, #2D3748); font-size:.9rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-input { width:100%; height:var(--control-height, 44px); padding:0 13px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; background:var(--parchment, #F5F1EB); color:var(--ink, #1A202C); font:inherit; transition:background var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), border-color var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)), box-shadow var(--transition, .2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1)); } .ds-input:hover { background:#f1ece5; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--accent, #1D4F5E); background:var(--card, #FFFFFF); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-pale, #E0F2F5); outline:none; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation Link
components.description: A full-width workspace destination with a pale teal current state.
components.html: NotesScribe
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:3px; } .ds-nav-link { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:2.5rem; padding:.55rem .7rem; border-radius:.45rem; color:var(--slate, #2D3748); text-decoration:none; font:inherit; } .ds-nav-link:hover,.ds-nav-link:focus-visible,.ds-nav-link-current { background:rgba(29,79,94,.1); color:var(--accent, #1D4F5E); } .ds-nav-link-current { font-weight:700; }

components.name: Neutral Status Badge
components.description: A compact textual state label with a supporting dot.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; padding:.375rem .75rem; border:1px solid var(--border, #E2DED6); border-radius:999px; background:white; color:var(--slate, #2D3748); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1; } .ds-status-dot { width:.5rem; height:.5rem; border-radius:999px; background:var(--slate, #2D3748); }

components.name: Settings Card
components.description: A softly layered settings container with padded content rows.
components.css: .ds-card { display:grid; gap:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--border, #E2DED6); border-radius:var(--radius-lg, 22px); background:rgba(255,255,255,.94); color:var(--ink, #1A202C); } .ds-card-row { padding:18px; } .ds-card-row + .ds-card-row { border-top:1px solid var(--border, #E2DED6); } .ds-card h2 { margin:0; font:500 1.35rem/1.2 var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif); } .ds-card p { margin:.4rem 0 0; color:var(--muted, #718096); }

components.name: Quota Limit Selector
components.description: Admin-only native radio choice between a finite quota and Unlimited.
components.html: Daily tokens
components.css: .ds-quota-period { margin:0; padding:12px 0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, #E2DED6); } .ds-quota-period legend { margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--ink, #1A202C); font-weight:600; } .ds-quota-segments { display:flex; width:max-content; padding:2px; border:1px solid var(--admin-border-strong,var(--border-strong, #D8D2C8)); border-radius:7px; background:var(--card, #FFFFFF); } .ds-quota-segments label { position:relative; display:inline-flex; cursor:pointer; } .ds-quota-segments input { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; margin:0; opacity:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-quota-segments span { display:inline-block; padding:7px 13px; border-radius:5px; color:var(--slate, #2D3748); font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-quota-segments input:checked + span { background:var(--accent, #1D4F5E); color:white; } .ds-quota-segments input:focus-visible + span { outline:3px solid var(--admin-focus,#0b667b); outline-offset:2px; } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-quota-segments { width:100%; } .ds-quota-segments label { flex:1; justify-content:center; } }

narrative.overview:
OpenScribe’s visual language is calm, trustworthy and practical. It pairs paper-like warm surfaces with precise dark text and a restrained teal accent, leaving the content and the next useful action easy to find. The interface should feel considered and steady rather than like a flashy dashboard.

The product serves clinicians preparing reviewable drafts and technical administrators operating a deployment. This system records the current shared web styling and calls out the admin workspace’s deliberate accessibility overrides; those overrides are not global token replacements. Typography lists declared stacks, not a guarantee that a named font file is loaded. Maintain the product’s established terminology and target WCAG 2.2 AA without claiming certification.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and parchment surfaces with dark, readable text.
Deep Teal is a focused action and navigation accent.
Restrained and softly layered: borders define cards; shadows lift menus and dialogs.
Shared site values and admin-specific accessibility values remain distinct.
dos: Do use Paper, Parchment, Ink and Deep Teal as names for the existing shared values.
Do use borders to define resting cards and reserve larger shadows for menus and dialogs.
Do keep admin accessibility overrides scoped to admin until shared styles are separately reviewed.
Do keep the Scribe mobile drawer and admin mobile navigation disclosure distinct.
Do keep status labels textual and semantic, with color as supporting information.
Do preserve visible focus and forced-colors behavior in the admin workspace.
donts: Don't turn admin-specific muted, border, status or focus values into global tokens by copying them into shared styles.
Don't claim a named font is loaded; the styles declare fallback stacks without loading font assets.
Don't add flashy dashboard styling; the confirmed visual language is calm, trustworthy and practical.
Don't treat automated accessibility results as WCAG certification.
